description: This Python source file contains an integration test for AWS IoT MQTT asynchronous API, testing connection, subscription, publishing, message handling, and disconnection callbacks.

classes.name: CallbackManager
classes.description: Manages callback invocation records for MQTT events such as online, offline, message received, connect, disconnect, publish, subscribe, and unsubscribe acknowledgments.

methods.name: on_online
methods.description: Callback invoked when the client goes online; increments the online callback count.

methods.name: on_offline
methods.description: Callback invoked when the client goes offline; increments the offline callback count.

methods.name: on_message
methods.description: Callback invoked upon message receipt; increments the message callback count.

methods.name: connack
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving CONNACK; increments the connection acknowledgment count.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Callback invoked upon disconnection; increments the disconnect callback count.

methods.name: puback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon PUBACK; increments the publish acknowledgment count.

methods.name: suback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon SUBACK; increments the subscribe acknowledgment count.

methods.name: unsuback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon UNSUBACK; increments the unsubscribe acknowledgment count.

methods.name: get_random_string
methods.description: Generates a random lowercase string of specified length.
